text_block_list.text:
After school, hearing an energetic voice 
from the rooftop, I went up to check and 
found Katsuragi Ace――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――"Look down and you'll only see your own 
shadow! Always look forward and keep 
pressing on!!"
choice_data_list: Whoa, that startled me?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad, my bad! Looks like I gave you 
a fright.
choice_data_list: わっ、びっくりした！？

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm practicing my speech for the school 
assembly. Chairwoman Akikawa personally 
asked me to give a talk that would boost 
student morale!
choice_data_list: 何をしてたんだ？
何をしてたの？

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, just thinking that my speech might 
change everyone gives me a huge surge of 
motivation...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna seize victory in this 
major showdown!!
choice_data_list: You're really fired up...!
You're really fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna practice until I'm fully 
satisfied today! Feel free to stick around 
and listen!
choice_data_list: かなり気合いが入ってるな……！
かなり気合いが入ってるね……！

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Studying! Racing! Even just playing 
around! I want you to pick one thing and 
give it your absolute all!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"――In short, it's a matter of mindset! If 
you do it while hating every second, 
you'll just drag yourself down! To put it 
concretely――"

Even after 30 minutes had passed, there 
was no sign of Katsuragi Ace's speech 
ending anytime soon...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"――Even so, when you feel like breaking, 
lean on those around you! Because we're 
all students of the same Tracen Academy!!"
choice_data_list:
Hold on, stop! ...That's quite a 
masterpiece, isn't it?

Hold on, stop! ...That's quite a 
masterpiece, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we're just about halfway through so 
far.
choice_data_list: 一旦、ストップ！……すごい力作だな？
一旦、ストップ！……すごい力作だね？
choice_data_list_en: Hold on a second, stop! ...That's quite an impressive piece of work, isn't it?
Hold on a second, stop! ...That's quite an impressive piece of work, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The Chairwoman is counting on me, so I 
can't deliver a half-baked speech, can I?
choice_data_list:
Impressive! With a few tweaks, it'll be 
even better!

Impressive! With a few tweaks, it'll be 
even better!

(I should be patient and listen to the 
very end.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The Chairwoman is counting on me, so I 
can't deliver a half-baked speech, can I?
choice_data_list: すごいな！手を加えれば更によくなるよ！
すごい！手を加えれば更によくなるね！
（根気強く最後まで聞いてみよう）
choice_data_list_en: Impressive! With a little fine-tuning, it'll be even better!
Amazing! A few tweaks and it'll be even better!
(I'll patiently listen all the way to the end.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oh? You got a good idea? Let's hear it!
choice_data_list: すごいな！手を加えれば更によくなるよ！
すごい！手を加えれば更によくなるね！
（根気強く最後まで聞いてみよう）
choice_data_list_en: Impressive! With a little fine-tuning, it'll be even better!
Amazing! A few tweaks and it'll be even better!
(I'll patiently listen all the way to the end.)

text_block_list.text:
A long-winded speech only causes people to 
tune out. I advised Katsuragi Ace to keep 
it short and punchy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, makes sense! So keeping it short gets 
the point across better!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aww yeaaah!! This'll make the speech so 
much better!!

Katsuragi Ace keeps revising her speech. 
However, her motivation threatens to run 
wild again and turn it into another epic 
novel, making it impossible to take your 
eyes off her.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, full throttle all the way to 
the finish!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"――I believe in everyone's power! Let's do 
this! Let's show 'em what we've got, 
everyone! Thank you very much for 
listening!"
choice_data_list: (F-Finally done...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Having a listener made for great practice! 
Thanks to you, I'm in top shape. Much 
obliged!
choice_data_list: （よ、ようやく終わった……！）

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone, just you wait! I'm 
gonna give the greatest speech ever!

Once Katsuragi Ace gets fired up, she 
loses all restraint. You silently pray 
that this masterpiece won't become even 
longer during the real thing!
